scope: Dealer portal reliability and workflow improvements
changes: Tracking refreshes on tab visibility changes and isolates selected-order snapshots.
Unavailable product or FX pricing no longer blocks order, tracking and commission history.
Account cards distinguish unavailable data from an empty account.
Currency-change review is available outside the new-order form.
Cart lines require review when current stock, currency or level prices change.
Checkout totals use exact cents and enforce the existing order storage limit.
Unsubmitted product drafts cannot be silently omitted from a new order.
Uncertain order submissions preserve their original body and idempotency key for deliberate retry.
Uncertain payout requests preserve their original amount and key across portal section changes.
Saved payout requests reconcile only against the authenticated dealer's request keys.
Older account-summary reads cannot overwrite newer balances; reads during actions are queued.
Repeat-customer delivery reuse requires review and does not copy historical prices or payments.
Package allocation rows are grouped by product and SKU for history display and export.
Account changes in another tab invalidate the old page before another account's token can be used.

verification.data: Synthetic fixtures and isolated PostgreSQL-compatible databases; no live order or money writes
verification.static_markup: Seven synthetic component states rendered; blocked checkout and payout replay controls checked. This is not a browser visual review.

manual_checks_pending: Browser interaction and visual review using a dealer account on the deployed version.
Real Aras delivery updates and final delivery classification on the deployed version.
browser_acceptance_scenarios: Open own orders, commissions and tracking after pricing fails; retry prices without losing the checkout draft.
Change a level price or stock, refresh the catalog and confirm the affected cart line requires review.
Simulate a lost order response; confirm the form stays locked and retry reuses the original submission.
Simulate a lost payout response; switch sections and confirm the original request is recovered or replayed.
Reuse a previous recipient and confirm only reviewed delivery fields change, while cart prices stay intact.
Switch accounts in another tab and confirm the old page returns to login without submitting under the new account.
On an actual delivered shipment, compare the dealer tracking panel with Aras and the manager's order classification.
retry_scope: Recovery state stays in memory for the current panel session. After a full browser reload or logout, existing orders and payout requests must be checked before resubmission.
